## LEDGER

### (a) Registers and what each closed

**ENFORCEMENT** — `clear in-flight state when active scope changes`
Closed the defect itself. Ranked `packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/ScribbleManager/ScribbleManager.ts` #1 in tldraw alongside `LaserTool/childStates/Lasering.ts`, `overlays/ScribbleOverlayUtil.ts`, `tlschema/src/records/TLPageState.ts`. In query it closed `query-core/src/queryObserver.ts`, `query.ts`, `mutation.ts`, `mutationCache.ts`; in table `features/ColumnSizing.ts`, `RowSelection.ts`, `RowPagination.ts`; in xyflow `react/src/store/index.ts`, `svelte/src/lib/store/index.ts`, `system/src/xyhandle/XYHandle.ts`; in router `router-core/src/router.ts`, `Matches.ts`, the three `Transitioner.tsx`; in db `collection/state.ts`, `lifecycle.ts`, `sync.ts`, `subscription.ts`; in react-redux `src/utils/Subscription.ts`, `src/components/connect.tsx`.

**PAYLOAD** — `manager owns queued animation entries`
The register that reached what *builds* the trails rather than what clears them: `managers/TickManager/TickManager.ts` (the frame source the manager rides), `managers/EdgeScrollManager/EdgeScrollManager.ts`, `packages/utils/src/lib/throttle.ts`. Cross-repo it closed primitives' `presence/src/presence.tsx` and `toast/src/toast.tsx`, jotai's `src/vanilla/internals.ts`, RTK's `buildMiddleware/cacheLifecycle.ts` + `listenerMiddleware/index.ts`, query's `notifyManager.ts`/`queryCache.ts`/`retryer.ts`, xyflow's `system/src/utils/store.ts`, zustand's `middleware/subscribeWithSelector.ts`.

**CONTRACT** — `dispose lifecycle reset method exported`
Closed the published surfaces: `packages/editor/src/index.ts` (confirmed by `cross_repo_lookup symbol=ScribbleManager` as the re-exporter, and by grep at line 118), table's `core/table.ts` + the auto-reset feature files, db's `collection/lifecycle.ts`/`events.ts`, primitives' `dismissable-layer`/`focus-scope`/`collection`, redux `src/createStore.ts` + `src/types/store.ts`, reselect `src/createSelectorCreator.ts` + `src/weakMapMemoize.ts`, zustand `src/vanilla.ts`. **zod: effectively EMPTY** — only `ParseContext`/`ParseInput` type shapes; zod threads parse state through an argument rather than owning it on the schema, so it carries the contract only nominally.

**CROSSCUTTING** — `devtools serialize pending status snapshot`
Closed redux-devtools `app-core/src/reducers/instances.ts`, `redux-devtools-instrument/src/instrument.ts`, `rtk-query-monitor/src/selectors.ts`; query `query-core/src/hydration.ts` (*"pending dehydrated query … becomes success on hydration"*); RTK `query/core/buildSlice.ts` (*"Skips rehydrating in-flight entries"*) + `apiState.ts`; react `ReactFiberUnwindWork.js` and `react-dom-bindings/src/events/FallbackCompositionState.js` (`reset()` of module-level transient state); jotai `src/vanilla/internals.ts`.

| CROSSCUTTING (6/6) | redux-devtools, redux-toolkit, react, redux, jotai, query |

No row is short of its `repos[]`; 2.7 holds. Every one of the 16 roster repositories appears.

### Grounding for the verdict

`ScribbleItem` (ScribbleManager.ts:7-14) is `{id, scribble, timeoutMs, delayRemaining, prev, next}` and the internal `Session` (:48-56) is `{id, items, state, options, idleTimeoutHandle, fadeElapsed, totalPointsAtFadeStart}` — **neither records a page**. The manager owns `private sessions = new Map<string, Session>()` (:60) for the editor's whole lifetime, and `addPoint` (:281-296), `complete` (:305-316) and `stop` (:324-334) each iterate *every* session regardless of page.

The decisive counter-evidence is a bulk grep for `PageId` across all 18 managers: `SpatialIndexManager.ts` (10 matches), `CollaboratorsManager.ts` (4) and `SnapManager.ts` (1) record their page; `ScribbleManager.ts`, `ClickManager.ts`, `EdgeScrollManager.ts`, `InputsManager.ts`, `TickManager.ts`, `FontManager.ts` and `HistoryManager.ts` return **zero matches**. The siblings that do it right prove the omission is a defect, not a design.

Two notes on what this run did *not* settle. `shakedown` was refused after one call on budget, so PROBE 3 covers only `packages/editor` — the `packages/tldraw` text tier is unswept, and I routed around it via `dragnet`/`cross_repo_lookup` per 3.7 rather than treating it as absence. And outside tldraw the classifications rest on analysis prose and structural edges, not on verbatim reads: those files are ranked as candidates, which is why they sit below the tldraw block.
